patch_list: Raises the visible and add-location limits from 3 free / 30 Pro to 100 saved places. Keeps existing saved data and works independently of Pro. Phone testing pending.

Experimental original-APK startup attempt; dev.10 still showed Get this app from Play on the phone. Do not select for the working LiteAPKs APK. Disables two local checks, preserves native VM assets and does not grant paid server access.

Enables local Pro controls, hides Pro upsells and permits up to ten daily forecast rows when data is supplied. Paid radar/model data still uses the real account entitlement; this does not create a subscription. Phone testing pending.
Disables automatic subscription popups and review requests. Manual subscription actions, permission prompts and weather/outage notices remain available. Phone testing pending.
Removes the injected LiteAPKS / 9MOD promotional popup from Zoom Earth.
Stops the bundled banner controller from initializing or showing ads, and collapses the ad footer. Works independently of Pro. Phone testing pending.
